name: Qwen3.8 Flash Next
description: Precision-preserving text-only recipe for Qwen's official Qwen3.8 FP8 checkpoint on one NVIDIA GB10.

performance.note: Fixed 64-token complete-checkpoint probe; throughput missed the 5 tok/s Frontier floor by 0.01 tok/s and the remaining certification gates were not run.

limitations: Beta 0.1 FTW preparation preserves the official checkpoint's native 128x128 block-FP8 weights and scales without conversion-time requantization; the complete prepared artifact was byte-validated and served on GB10.
The measured 4.99 tok/s misses the 5 tok/s Frontier performance floor by 0.01 tok/s, although its 0.580 s warm TTFT is within the 20 s limit.
GB10-QWEN38-FRONTIER-001 certifies the superseded NVFP4-converted 0.3.0 artifact and does not transfer to this official FP8 0.4.0 recipe.
QSA selection currently runs eagerly, so CUDA graph capture is disabled.
The published checkpoint is multimodal; initial Spark Lab certification is text-only.
Exact 64K recall, capability, quality, and 60-minute endurance gates have not yet been run on the official FP8 artifact.
The measurement host had 2.73 GiB of unrelated swap resident at preflight; the measured request swapped 516 pages in and no pages out.
